items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Celestine. The, what you call them? Celestine in there.

ctx.x: And we opened up and let them go in the graveyard. But afterwards we would look for the band that you was gone. Look at that. Them other band you see and you're going to see.
No, no, Excelsior didn't go to Ricker. Celestine. The, what you call them? Celestine in there. Yeah. Couldn't catch him with a, with a ten foot pull.
Couldn't catch him nowhere. Well you know what, it's what after we get out, you know what it's going to be. Who, who tied the dog? That's right.
